title: The Project Nobody Wanted to Lead
title_ja: 誰も代表を引き受けなかった活動
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事・制度は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・法律・医療指示を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Four classmates were assigned to prepare an exhibition about their neighborhood for the school festival.
sentences.ja: 4人のクラスメートが学校祭で地域について展示する課題を与えられた。

sentences.en: Although everyone was interested in the topic, nobody immediately volunteered to become the leader.
sentences.ja: 全員がテーマに関心を持ったが、誰もすぐには代表に立候補しなかった。

sentences.en: They worried that the leader would be responsible for nearly all the work.
sentences.ja: 代表がほとんどすべての仕事を負うのではないかと心配した。

sentences.en: One member suggested discussing the role before selecting a particular person.
sentences.ja: ある委員は人を選ぶ前に役割を話し合うことを提案した。

sentences.en: Together, the students listed tasks such as contacting the teacher and organizing materials.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは教師への連絡や資料整理などの仕事を列挙した。

sentences.en: They discovered that the tasks required different skills and could be divided among them.
sentences.ja: 仕事には異なる技能が必要で分担できると分かった。

sentences.en: One student offered to manage the schedule because she enjoyed setting realistic deadlines.
sentences.ja: 一人は現実的な期限設定が好きなので日程管理を申し出た。

sentences.en: Another agreed to communicate with the teacher and report important information.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒は教師への連絡と重要な情報の報告を引き受けた。

sentences.en: The remaining students took responsibility for gathering photographs and preparing explanation panels.
sentences.ja: 残る生徒は写真を集め説明パネルを準備する責任を負った。

sentences.en: They wrote their assignments on a shared sheet so everyone could check their progress.
sentences.ja: 全員が進捗を確認できるよう共有の用紙に担当を書いた。

sentences.en: They also promised to review the distribution of work whenever someone experienced unexpected difficulties.
sentences.ja: 誰かが予想外の困難に直面したら分担を見直すと約束した。

sentences.en: As a result, the students felt more comfortable asking each other for assistance.
sentences.ja: その結果、生徒は互いに助けを求めやすくなった。

sentences.en: However, sharing responsibilities did not automatically prevent every disagreement during the project.
sentences.ja: しかし責任を分担しても活動中の意見の相違すべてを自動的に防げるわけではなかった。

sentences.en: Two students disagreed about the amount of information that should appear on each panel.
sentences.ja: 二人は各パネルに載せる情報量について意見が異なった。

sentences.en: Instead of expecting one leader to settle the issue, they compared the designs with their original purpose.
sentences.ja: 一人の代表に解決を期待せず、案を当初の目的と照らし合わせた。

sentences.en: They eventually chose a combination of the two designs and explained their reasons.
sentences.ja: 最終的に二案を組み合わせ、その理由を説明した。

sentences.en: After the exhibition, the students reflected on the advantages and limitations of their approach.
sentences.ja: 展示後、生徒は方法の利点と限界を振り返った。

sentences.en: Clear responsibilities had encouraged cooperation, but respectful discussion had remained necessary throughout the activity.
sentences.ja: 明確な責任分担は協力を促したが、活動全体を通じて尊重し合う議論が必要だった。

sentences.en: They understood that leadership could involve supporting others rather than controlling every decision alone.
sentences.ja: リーダーシップは一人で全決定を支配するのでなく他者を支えることも含むと理解した。

sentences.en: For them, effective teamwork meant creating conditions in which each member could contribute.
sentences.ja: 彼らにとって効果的な協力とは各人が貢献できる条件を作ることだった。

questions.prompt: Why did no one initially volunteer?
options: They had no interest in the topic.
They had finished the work already.
They were not permitted to choose.
They worried that the leader would do most of the work.
questions.explanation_ja: 仕事の集中を心配した。
必要な作業を列挙した。

questions.prompt: Why did one student offer to manage the schedule?
options: She wanted to cancel the festival.
She was the only one with photographs.
questions.explanation_ja: 期限設定が好きだった。

questions.prompt: What did the shared sheet show?
Why review the distribution of work?
options: To respond when someone faced difficulties.
To prevent people from asking for assistance.
To keep every duty permanently fixed.
To choose a different exhibition topic.
questions.explanation_ja: 困難が生じた際に対応するため。

options: The date of the school festival.
The amount of information on each panel.

options: They made the teacher decide everything.
